propositions: Guardrail-intervened and content-policy-blocked LLM calls are classified as CHANGE_INPUT but rendered with a generic 'too large / malformed' message that misreports the failure mode.
The message_for() function needs an optional finish_reason parameter to distinguish content_filter blocks from genuine size/format rejections and return a guardrail-specific message.
finish_reason is already available at all three render sites (LLMOutcome.diagnostic, persisted coverage diagnostic, and _outcome.diagnostic) and must be threaded through to message_for() call sites.

Unit tests must verify content_filter + CHANGE_INPUT returns the new guardrail message, non-content_filter CHANGE_INPUT returns the generic message, and backward compatibility is preserved when finish_reason is omitted.
